question: What is purifying when mantras are omitted in the world-protector weapon rite?
premises: The sequence runs door, site, support, guru.
In the rite of world-protector weapons, mantras are omitted.
inference: Omission of mantras in that rite still leaves all purifying.
uncertainties: The exact referent of lokapāstra is unclear.
Whether guru-krama modifies the whole sequence is unclear.
plain_english: What need of too much? In the order of door, site, support, and guru, in the rite of world-protector weapons, having omitted mantras, all is purifying.
